messages:
incident-bot: Paging on-call for incidents/inc_4100: P99 latency spike observed on continuous-batching path for streaming endpoints in us-west-2. SLO alert: p99 > 1.2s for 5m. impact: some streaming sessions stalled. docs: https://internal/redwood/inc/4100 :rotating_light:
Ash: on it. seeing tail at 1.5s on the cont-batch kube deployment.
Jordan: I can take first-hand if you want to triage. which model and pool?
Ash: model=redwood/fast-7b, pool=contbatch-usw2-gpupool-3, seqlen distribution skewed (lots of short ~8 and some long ~2048).
Mira: any recent deploys? or config changes to scheduler?
Ash: no code deploys in last 30m. scheduler flags unchanged. some autoscaler churned 2 nodes 12m ago.
ops-bot: Autoscaler event: scale-up triggered by pod_cpu at 2024-11-05T16:07:12Z (2 -> 4 nodes).
Jordan: that scale churn could cause KV eviction thrash. can we check mem pressure and kv hit rate? Ash can you attach top logs?
Ash: past 10m: KV cache evicts spiked to 40% eviction rate, kv_hit_ratio dropped from 0.98 -> 0.7. Logs: ```WARN kv_cache: evicting key seq=1 size=1.2MB
WARN kv_cache: eviction_rate=0.42
```
Riya: Customer impact: a few customers reported slow generative chat responses and one support ticket claiming streaming stalls. CS routed to eng.
Mira: hypothesis: mixed sequence lengths cause packer to create large heterogenous batches; scheduler fairness prefers big batches and short requests get stuck behind long ones -> tail amplification. also KV thrash due to node churn.
Jordan: mitigation plan: 1) enable short-prefill preemptive packing for cont-batch route (shed long seq into separate queue) 2) temporary reduce max_batch_size for contbatch-usw2 to 64 3) increase kv cache reserved memory on nodes 4) roll update scheduler fairness weight to favor latency-sensitive routes.
Ash: starting actions: applying k8s patch to change deployment env CONTBATCH_MAX_BATCH=64 and set CONTBATCH_SHORT_BUCKET=true. will patch one AZ at a time.
ops-bot: kubectl apply -f /deploy/contbatch/usw2/patch-4100.yml succeeded (deployment/contbatch-usw2 updated)
Jordan: I'm toggling scheduler weight: /admin/scheduler set-weight contbatch_latency_sensitive=1.5 -> old 1.0.
Mira: increasing kv reservation on nodepool config now (bumping from 6GB -> 10GB per pod).
Ash: rolling patch started: pod/contbatch-abcde terminating -> new pod ready.
Ash: quick telemetry: p99 fell from 1.5s -> 0.9s in the updated AZ within 2m. overall p99 across cluster down to 1.0s.
Riya: logged customer notification: ticket #12345 updated: "We observed intermittent streaming stalls; engineers are actively mitigating. We'll follow up when resolved."
Jordan: next steps: monitor for 15m, if stable revert max_batch back up to 128 but keep short-prefill true. schedule postmortem to analyze batching policy and autoscaler interactions.
Mira: agenda for postmortem: - root cause (mixed seqlen + autoscaler churn + kv cache size) - why scheduler weight default favored throughput - reproduce with loadtest - potential config defaults (short-prefill on by default for streaming routes) - add regression alert on kv_eviction_rate > 0.2
Ash: noted. will leave handoff to Jordan in 10m. tagging @oncall-next. :thumbsup:
Jordan: taking handoff. monitoring dashboard: https://dash/internal/contbatch/usw2, will escalate to SRE if p99 > 1.1s for another 10m.
incident-bot: Incident inc_4100 severity: mitigation in progress. pages: 0, customer-impact: partial, handoff: Jordan -> end of thread updates to follow.
